notes.title: July 2025 Update: Tutorial Complete!
notes.notes: [h2]Update[/h2][p]The Tutorial is complete with 9 quests to help teach you the gameplay! We've had a few play tests and we've added more content to contextualize the storyline :)[/p][p]We're super excited about the versatility of these newest additions: In Game Cut Scenes, Quest pop up messages and trackers, as well as player speech bubbles.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Introduction Cutscene[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/bcb918212f83865ab62bd1f35c49f13255c4a48c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Quests[/b][/h2][p]We have 4 quest types available: Gather, Craft, Kill, and Search. In the tutorial, various questlines will guide you through the basics of exploration, farming, and interacting with Alien plantlife.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pop-Up Messages[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/40d219042ebe9d22cded332b5f01bd3a05861f50.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Quest Tracking[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/f8a60bd573da446220a19e7f587300f1b03eee50.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Player Speech Bubbles[/b][/h2][p]When your player interacts with special objects, you will trigger a speech bubble to give more context into what you're seeing![/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/012e9a7b7088dc04cf6f63779dbe96d16713b65a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/50e95b9b5af0b4bba02a576ef456ae2188c616ed.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Thanks for checking in![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist XenoFields: Frontier to stay up to date on the demo release! Follow us on [url="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7knXf3hLwUAN3bncmyrM6g"]YouTube[/url] and [url="https://www.instagram.com/coadventurestudios/"]Instagram[/url].[/p]

notes.title: May 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We've finished the coding which controls the flow of the tutorial and we've moved onto improving the visuals and Quality of Life (ie. ease of gameplay).

[h2][b]Decorating Your Bunker![/b][/h2]
We couldn't help ourselves... so we extended the building placement system from the Crash Zone to allow for decorating your starting bunker! Flooring, wallpaper, furniture, and wall decal can be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/37d66230a83d125390b40f4c53b5e4260d4be918.gif[/img]



[h2][b]Important Building Destruction[/b][/h2]
Important buildings must be hit with your hammer 3 times in 5 secongs to destroy it. This ensures that you don't accidently destroy them! We've also added code so that the storage space drops all of its contents on the ground upon destruction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482746/843e8e596ac41c895f7bfe9adb01ef517f960bf1.gif[/img]

notes.title: April 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We're hard at work on the Tutorial. In this effort, we've created Help Menus to guide the player. Don't worry, you can easily hide these menus once you've gotten a handle on the basics. We've also started polishing the in-game visualizations by adding footprints to the Player. When you're walking on the Crash Zone's bioluminscent moss-covered ground at night, your footprints glow!

notes.title: March 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We're hard at work on the Tutorial. In this effort, we've updated Spaceship map to give it a more "you've just crash landed" feeling and added new Player animations to better emerse you in this alien world.
